name: Valdestillas (Spain)
description: Green field charged with five yellow inverted triangles (splinters) arranged in saltire.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 5 April 1991 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 12 April 1991; the flag is square, green, with five splinters of gold placed in saltire.

features.role: five inverted triangles arranged in saltire
